note: Catalogue capture for the held tier-5 English Wikipedia article on the Ural-4320. Every value is grade claimed and the registry marks primary_held false. The article publishes the gross vehicle weight rating, the dimensions, the engine, the manual transmission and the top speed. It publishes no kerb or operating weight and no ground clearance.
